name: Graveyard / Reanimator
summary: Fill the graveyard, then return creature cards to play or hand for tempo/value. Spans cheap single-target reanimation, mass returns, self-recursion creatures, graveyard tutors, and the commanders that reward the loop.
_status_note: Awaiting Gate 2 + Gate 3 approval by local-board. 20/20 = 100% canon recall validated empirically against Scryfall API on 2026-05-14.

canon_provenance.from_existing_decks: Pulled from `eternal-harvest` and `silverquill-the-disputant` deck.json (the two decks tagged `graveyard-reanimator`). Shared staples: Reanimate, Animate Dead, Necromancy, Living Death, Buried Alive, Bloodghast, Reassembling Skeleton, Phyrexian Reclamation (silverquill only — but format-defining engine).
canon_provenance.from_edhrec_archetype_pages: Sevinne's Reclamation, Karmic Guide, Sun Titan, Eternal Witness — universal EDH reanimator/recursion staples that score in EDHREC top-20 across Karador/Meren/Alesha/Muldrotha pages.
canon_provenance.from_commanders: Meren of Clan Nel Toth, Karador (Ghost Chieftain), Mikaeus the Unhallowed, Sidisi (Brood Tyrant) — the four canonical reanimator-engine commanders by idiom (return-at-EoT, cast-from-yard, undying, self-mill).
canon_provenance.from_targets: Archon of Cruelty included as the canonical fat reanimation target — the recipe must surface high-MV ETB-or-attack threats people actually cheat in.
canon_provenance.from_combo_pieces: Mikaeus + persist/undying lines, Karmic Guide + Reveillark loops, and Buried Alive + Victimize lines all show up on Commander Spellbook for graveyard-reanimator combos; these canon picks anchor the well-known engines.

single_target_reanimation_spells.intent: Spells and auras that put or return a creature card from a graveyard to the battlefield, the bread-and-butter of the archetype.
queries: f:commander o:"creature card" o:"graveyard" o:"onto the battlefield"
f:commander o:"return target creature card" o:"graveyard to the battlefield"
f:commander o:"return enchanted creature card to the battlefield"
f:commander o:"creature cards in your graveyard" o:"return" o:battlefield

mass_and_permanent_reanimation.intent: Whole-graveyard sweeps and 'return target permanent card' effects (Sevinne's, Sun Titan-style recursion). Smaller cluster than single-target but catches game-ending swings.
queries: f:commander o:"creature cards from" o:graveyard o:battlefield
f:commander o:"return target permanent card" o:graveyard o:battlefield

graveyard_tutors.intent: Tutors that load creature cards directly into your yard — the setup half of every reanimate-target play.
queries: f:commander o:"into your graveyard" o:"search your library"

self_recursion_creatures.intent: Creatures that return themselves from graveyard — repeatable engines that don't burn a reanimation spell each cycle.
queries: f:commander t:creature o:"return this card from your graveyard"

hand_recursion_engines.intent: Repeatable engines that return creature cards from graveyard to hand — Phyrexian Reclamation, Tortured Existence, and ETB-Witness-style triggers.
queries: f:commander o:"return target creature card" o:"graveyard" o:"hand"
f:commander t:creature o:enters o:"return target card from your graveyard"

reanimator_commanders.intent: Commanders that anchor the archetype across the four canonical engine idioms: return-at-end-step (Meren), cast-from-yard (Karador), undying (Mikaeus), and self-mill-into-tokens (Sidisi).
queries: is:commander o:"cast a creature spell from your graveyard"
is:commander o:"creature cards" o:"into your graveyard from your library"

big_reanimation_targets.intent: Fat creatures with enters-or-attacks triggers that justify the reanimation tempo investment.
queries: f:commander t:creature mv>=7 o:"enters or attacks"

canon_recall.note: Tight 13-result query. Archon of Cruelty ranks #1 by EDHREC. Other strong hits: Ulamog the Defiler, Emrakul the Promised End — the actual targets reanimator decks want.

wildcard.intent: Intentionally broad sweep — looter / discard-then-return engines that don't fit the precise sub-recipes above. High noise, run sparingly.
queries: f:commander o:"discard a card" o:"return" o:graveyard

canon_recall.note: Wildcard is not validated against canon — it exists to surface oddities like Trading Post, Obsessive Stitcher, Macabre Waltz, Awaken the Honored Dead that the precise queries miss.

excludes.graveyard_hate_collateral: -o:"exile target player's graveyard" -o:"exile all cards from"
excludes._note: Optional post-fetch filter. Prevents Bojuka Bog / Leyline of the Void variants leaking into the reanimator candidate pool. Spliced when a deck signals a self-only reanimator package.

runtime_semantics.color_identity_splice: Append `id<=<deck color identity>` per query at runtime.
runtime_semantics.decklist_exclusion: Post-fetch — filter out any name already in decklist or candidates.json top-50.

validation_summary.validation_method: Each sub-recipe query was run live against api.scryfall.com (order=edhrec, cap=300). Canon recall = (canon cards surfaced by at least one query in any sub-recipe) / total canon.

noise_sample.single_target_reanimation_spells: Reanimate, Animate Dead, Finale of Devastation, Living Death, Rise of the Dark Realms — top-5 are reanimation/recursion variants, no false positives in top-20.
noise_sample.mass_and_permanent_reanimation: Sun Titan, Sevinne's Reclamation, Angel of Indemnity, Court of Ardenvale — all permanent-recursion, clean signal.
noise_sample.graveyard_tutors: Entomb, Buried Alive, Goblin Engineer, Unmarked Grave, Lively Dirge — all yard tutors, clean.
noise_sample.self_recursion_creatures: Reassembling Skeleton, Bloodghast, Metalwork Colossus, Multani Yavimaya's Avatar, Jarad — all self-recur creatures, clean.
noise_sample.hand_recursion_engines: Phyrexian Reclamation, Tortured Existence, Honest Rutstein, Oversold Cemetery, Stitch Together — strong hand-return cluster.
noise_sample.reanimator_commanders: Syr Konrad (death-payoff, weak match), Sheoldred Whispering One, Junji Midnight Sky — query A overshoots into adjacent death-trigger commanders; queries B/C/D are tight. Noise is acceptable since these are still graveyard-adjacent commanders.
noise_sample.big_reanimation_targets: Archon of Cruelty (#1), Threefold Thunderhulk, Colossal Grave-Reaver, Ureni of the Unwritten, Sin Spira's Punishment — tight 13-result list, all are credible reanimation targets.
noise_sample.wildcard: Trading Post, Toph Hardheaded Teacher, Bag of Holding, The Restoration of Eiganjo, The Underworld Cookbook — surfaces looter/recursion artifacts the precise queries miss.
